newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Wembley bond issue, warrants sale aborted.
newsitem.headline: Wembley bond issue, warrants sale aborted.

text.p: Wembley Industries Bhd said a previously-proposed 263 million ringgit bond issue and offer to sell 86.69 million warrants have been aborted.

In a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Friday, the developer and industrial concern said it was also revising a proposed rights issue to 216.71 million new shares on a three-for-two basis at 2.20 ringgit a share.
In an announcement in July, Wembley proposed a rights issue of 57.79 million new shares on a two-for-five basis at 3.25 ringgit apiece.
Wembley gave no reason for the changes.

The rights issue will raise funds to finance the development of Plaza Rakyat, a 2.0 billion ringgit shopping, office and hotel complex. It will also be used to repay bank debt and for working capital, the statement said.
As a result of the rights issue, Wembley said its share capital will rise to 216.71 million ringgit from 144.48 million.
